templates.why_chosen: Densest figure in the batch (14 components, nesting depth 3, star-rated): two separate inside legends, one for chunk state and one for solid/dashed-red flow type, sit top-left above N replicated inference instances.
templates.what_to_learn: When one figure needs two kinds of legend, state (chunk fill/hatch) and flow type (solid vs dashed-red arrows), keep both inside the frame but in separate corners rather than merging them, and let the replicated instances below use a plain ellipsis so the control components above stay the visual anchor.

templates.why_chosen: The same figure judged for replicated-grid: Instance 1, 2, 3, ellipsis, N sit in one Inference Engine Pool row beneath the Request Buffer and Context Manager, each showing its own row of colored chunk states.
templates.what_to_learn: Keep the coordinator (Request Buffer, Context Manager) visually above the replicated pool it drives, index the instances 1, 2, 3, ellipsis, N, and repeat the same per-instance visual device, a row of colored chunk cells, in every box so the reader can read each instance's state directly.
